text:
deploybot: Proposal: unpin SDK v2.10.0 for model-group 'summarize-wide' following runtime v3.3.0 kernel fix. Canary shows latency improvement and reduced mem spikes. Unpin window 2026-04-01T04:00Z..2026-04-01T06:00Z. Owner: @jen. Please ack and list any blockers.

jen: ack. I'll own rollout. Plan: region-by-region (eu -> us -> apac), 20m observe per region, stagger canaries, update release notes and partners.

marco: quick compatibility note — tokenizer update in SDK 2.10.0 changed unicode normalization for zero-width joins. Most models fine, but reranker pipelines might see score drift. Recommend setting compatibility toggle tokenizer-strict=false during rollout for affected cohorts.

lina: QA update: long-input smoke + perf tests passed in eu-canary (10k tokens). Rerank delta observed: mean -0.3% on our sample set. No functional failures.

priya: embeddings/semantic-search teams: we ran 24h telemetry in canary. Score shift within tolerances, but we'll watch for drift on exact-match endpoints. I can approve unpin for eu/us, but want APAC gated until post-rollout telemetry (2h).

jen: noted. gating APAC until @priya gives post-roll signal. Also adding feature-flag steps to runbook so rollback is atomic.

oncall: I'll standby for the window. Alert thresholds set: 95th latency +20% or error-rate >0.5% -> page. Panels: https://grafana.company/d/summaries/unpin-3770003333

devops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: https://infra/ops/maintenance/3770003333 — assigned to jen and oncall. Autoscaler warmup window extended to 10m for this cohort.

jen: rollback procedure (prep): 1) set feature-flag sdk_compat_toggle=true for summarize-wide 2) route 5% traffic to pinned SDK 2.9.8 fallback 3) monitor metrics 4) if anomalies, run hotpatch rollback. Hotpatch branch: gitlab.com/redwood/sdk/-/tree/hotfix/rollpin-2.9.8

jen: rollback command example (dry-run):
```
/deploy pin sdk summarize-wide --to 2.9.8 --region eu --dry-run
```

marco: note: toggling tokenizer-strict off needs a config push to model-routing service. Patch prepared in PR 8421. Jenna, can you include that in the preflight?

jen: will include. preflight checklist updated in the runbook.

lina: tagging @priya to confirm telemetry gates: please confirm thresholds you need for APAC unblock.

priya: APAC unblock criteria: 2h of steady 95th < baseline+10% AND rerank drift <0.5%. I'll post signal in this thread when green.

devops-bot: Canary tickets: eu-canary started at 2026-04-01T01:40Z. Canary run id: canary-3770003333-eu

jen: I'll notify #status and partners 30m before start. If no objections, scheduling unpin for eu at 04:00Z. react with :eyes: when you are watching.

oncall: :eyes: on dashboards and ready to page on thresholds.

marco: quick checklist item — add a short note to release notes about the tokenizer normalization change and link to migration FAQ. Partners expect a heads up.

jen: will add to release notes. thanks. (reacted :thumbsup:)
